name: GD Helper
description: FPS Counter, Auto Play Bot, Click Sounds, and In-Game Settings. Updated for GD 2.2081.

fps-enabled.name: Show FPS Counter
fps-enabled.description: Display FPS in top-left corner during gameplay

auto-play-enabled.name: Auto Play Mode
auto-play-enabled.description: Bot plays the level. Progress is NOT saved! Works best on Easy-Hard levels.

click-sound-enabled.name: Click Sounds
click-sound-enabled.description: Play sounds when clicking and releasing (works with bot too)
